<style>

#app{height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 10px env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}

.b{background:#334155;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.b:active{transform:scale(.95)}.b.on{background:#6366f1}
section{width:100%;flex:1;min-height:0}

<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>🏗️ Stack Tower</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Chạm đúng lúc để khối trượt rơi khít lên tháp. Lệch bao nhiêu bị cắt bấy nhiêu. Xây đủ số tầng để qua màn.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script>
const GAME={key:'stack'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{$('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{$('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=$('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();$('#play').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=false;$('#md').hidden=true;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';$('#lv').textContent='';
 $('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 $('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;$('#md').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=true;$('#play').hidden=false;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='visible';$('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=$('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){$('#mt').textContent=t;$('#mx').textContent=x;const m=$('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});$('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
$('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
$('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

const BH=22;
let cv,cx,CW,CH,sc,HL,bl,mv,dirn,spd,goal,perf,tol,w0,cam,fallp,raf,dead,lastT,lv,lastDrop,dpr;
function start(l){
 lv=l;dead=false;goal=12+Math.floor(l*.22);w0=Math.max(80,150-l*.5);tol=Math.max(2.5,8-l*.05);
 bl=[{x:(300-w0)/2,w:w0}];perf=0;cam=0;fallp=[];lastDrop=0;nextB();
 const b=$('#board');b.className='st';b.innerHTML='<canvas></canvas>';cv=b.firstChild;cx=cv.getContext('2d');
 cv.onpointerdown=e=>{e.preventDefault();drop()};relayout();
 setInfo('Tầng: <b id="fl">0/'+goal+'</b>');
 say('Chạm (hoặc phím Space) đúng lúc để khối trượt rơi khít lên tầng dưới.');
 cancelAnimationFrame(raf);lastT=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function onStop(){dead=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
function relayout(){if(!cv)return;const w=Math.min(innerWidth-20,420),h=Math.max(260,Math.min(innerHeight-195,w*1.4));dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;CW=w;CH=h;sc=w/300;HL=h/sc;cv.width=CW*dpr;cv.height=CH*dpr;cv.style.width=CW+'px';cv.style.height=CH+'px'}
function nextB(){const t=bl[bl.length-1],f=bl.length-1;spd=Math.min(330,70+lv*1.3+f*3);dirn=f%2?-1:1;mv={x:dirn>0?-t.w/2:300-t.w/2,w:t.w}}
const yOf=i=>HL-30-(i+1)*BH+cam;
const colr=i=>'hsl('+((i*12+200)%360)+' 70% 55%)';
function drop(){
 if(over||dead)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastDrop<120)return;lastDrop=now;
 const t=bl[bl.length-1],ox=Math.max(mv.x,t.x),ex=Math.min(mv.x+mv.w,t.x+t.w),ov=ex-ox,n=bl.length;
 if(ov<=0){fallp.push({x:mv.x,w:mv.w,y:yOf(n)-cam,vy:0,i:n});draw();fail('Khối rơi trượt khỏi tháp. Bạn đạt tầng '+(n-1)+'/'+goal+'.');return}
 let nb;
 if(Math.abs(mv.x-t.x)<=tol){perf++;nb={x:t.x,w:t.w};if(perf>=3&&nb.w<w0){const g=Math.min(6,w0-nb.w);nb.x-=g/2;nb.w+=g;say('Hoàn hảo liên tiếp! Khối được nới rộng.')}else say(perf>1?'Hoàn hảo x'+perf+'!':'Khít hoàn hảo!')}
 else{perf=0;nb={x:ox,w:ov};say('');if(mv.x<t.x)fallp.push({x:mv.x,w:t.x-mv.x,y:yOf(n)-cam,vy:0,i:n});else fallp.push({x:ex,w:mv.x+mv.w-ex,y:yOf(n)-cam,vy:0,i:n})}
 bl.push(nb);const f=bl.length-1;$('#fl')&&($('#fl').textContent=f+'/'+goal);
 if(f>=goal){draw();win('Tháp đã cao '+goal+' tầng!');return}
 nextB();
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code=='Space'&&!$('#play').hidden&&$('#board').classList.contains('st')){e.preventDefault();drop()}});
function loop(t){if(dead)return;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);const dt=Math.min(40,t-(lastT||t));lastT=t;
 mv.x+=dirn*spd*dt/1000;if(mv.x>300-mv.w/2){mv.x=300-mv.w/2;dirn=-1}if(mv.x<-mv.w/2){mv.x=-mv.w/2;dirn=1}
 const tg=Math.max(0,(bl.length-6)*BH);cam+=(tg-cam)*Math.min(1,dt*.008);
 fallp.forEach(f=>{f.vy+=.0015*dt;f.y+=f.vy*dt});fallp=fallp.filter(f=>f.y<HL+80);
 draw()}
function draw(){
 cx.setTransform(dpr*sc,0,0,dpr*sc,0,0);const g=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,HL);g.addColorStop(0,'#1e1b4b');g.addColorStop(1,'#0f172a');cx.fillStyle=g;cx.fillRect(0,0,300,HL);
 bl.forEach((b,i)=>{cx.fillStyle=colr(i);cx.fillRect(b.x,yOf(i),b.w,BH-1)});
 cx.fillStyle=colr(bl.length);cx.fillRect(mv.x,yOf(bl.length),mv.w,BH-1);
 fallp.forEach(f=>{cx.fillStyle=colr(f.i);cx.fillRect(f.x,f.y+cam,f.w,BH-1)});
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
